method: Profiled medians use completed frame records emitted after NATIVERENDER measurement-start, then exclude five post-marker windows (including the first possibly straddling window); CPU passes match retained window IDs. Separate harness aggregate statistics and profiling-disabled control runs use their own post-startup measurement intervals. Meter isolation changes only HUD_SPRITES with HUD_GLYPHS on. Profiling-disabled solo/combat comparisons toggle both HUD caches together; all previous optimizations remain enabled.
